contour_push.description: Independent learned boundary-adjacency encoder, role and learned contour attention pooling, causal gated memory and current native-command mixture. Geometry-conditioned instance relocation; no alphabet or demonstration-order input.

visual_push.description: Independent learned target-marked global RGB, target/tool detail, calibrated wrist RGB and foreground/RGB goal streams with causal gated memory and native-command mixture.

preprocessing.cuts: frozen cut_v3: all 22 original segments, unchanged ranges and exclusions
preprocessing.chart: third undistorted original 1280x720 pixel coordinates; 2-pixel internal raster
preprocessing.perception: automatic brown-material connected components; white-support hull; forward-only assignment with uncertainty
preprocessing.tracking: 90-row lost-track lifetime; never use a lost mask as current foreground
preprocessing.action_source: finite action_json.dq only, cached in float64
preprocessing.time_weight: elapsed time; 0.5-second mass cap on contiguous identical-command runs; equal segment mass
preprocessing.goal_labels: last included paired row and frozen original raw goal boxes; masks are inferred, not verified
preprocessing.future_target: three-row displacement only if both endpoints are eligible within same segment
preprocessing.augmentation: bounded photometry and nonlatest causal-history dropout; no scene/action rotations

dependencies: Only supplied paired RGB, recording metadata, numpy, OpenCV, scipy, torch and framework read-only public access. No downloaded weights, torchvision, alphabet templates, raw depth, semantic labels or generic pretrained recognizer are assumed. Packages use the interface-provided versions.
adaptations: API-owned executable material-specific deterministic foreground/causal tracker replaces the assumed unavailable generic learned perception. This accepts previously unseen brown planar silhouettes but is not generic-object segmentation. Both motor policies are trained from scratch independently; single-command Gaussian mixtures are chosen independently instead of diffusion. RGB resolutions and history are reduced for bounded cache and 24-GiB execution; original pairing/chart mapping is retained. No verified table homography or tool silhouette exists: only bounded, acknowledged 2D rigid similarity goals are supported; projected TCP is an unverified point, never clearance/contact truth. Goal_observed is explicitly geometric agreement only and never successor readiness.
limitations: Two episodes cannot establish unseen-shape/material/friction or semantic word generalization. Brown-on-light-support segmentation can fragment, merge or confuse instances; confidence and orientation ties are heuristic, not calibrated. No recognizer, word planner, collision-free planner, contact detector, tool-clearance measurement, full perspective renderer or robot actuation is supplied. Registration failures and missing observations/commands are counted, not imputed. Native candidate units/order/timing require independently verified recording-controller interpretation before decode can format a command. All safety and layout/readability checks remain external commissioning/HLA responsibilities; no performance ranking or success claim follows from training.
